company: UMass Lowell - Miner School of Computer and Information Sciences
items: Migrated 28,000+ Alliance to End Plastic Waste (AEPW) records into an analytical PostgreSQL schema, reducing query times by approximately 70\% and strengthening data integrity.
Designed and implemented AUDA, a Python analytics platform for data cleaning, preprocessing, model execution, and visualization.
Developed and evaluated machine learning workflows to detect anomalies, forecast trends, and reconstruct missing plastic waste and resin consumption data across 192 countries.
Built a Python CLI using Typer to automate analytics workflows and improve reproducibility.
Delivered a backend for a blood specimen management platform using Midway.js, with JWT authentication and RESTful APIs for specimen registration and processing status updates.
Migrated 90+ API endpoints from Spring Boot to JavaScript/TypeScript, documented APIs in Swagger, and coordinated integration with frontend engineers.
Designed a microservices architecture to isolate service failures and simplify maintenance, implementing an initial user service with gRPC communication.
Developed a conference management backend for a WeChat mini-program with ThinkPHP 5, MySQL, Redis session authentication, and RESTful APIs.
Implemented QR code check-in with WeChat geolocation validation, restricting attendance registration to users within the venue’s allowed radius and one check-in per user per conference.
Integrated WeChat Pay for conference registration payments and refunds upon cancellation.
Deployed the application on Alibaba Cloud Linux servers, configured Nginx reverse proxy and load balancing, and managed application processes with systemd.
